findings.what: The module title claims 'every ladder property it has, beside ¬ causally compact, in one statement'. Five causality-sort ladder properties the half-plane has are not conjuncts: causally_open_future, locally_push_up, locally_causally_open, locally_causally_open_future and has_chronal_neighbour. Each follows from a conjunct by a one-premise ladder edge (causally_open ⇒ causally_open_future, push_up ⇒ locally_push_up, causally_open ⇒ locally_causally_open, chronal_neighbours ⇒ has_chronal_neighbour). The theorem's own docstring ('has each ladder property below') and the README row are accurate.
findings.fix: Retitle, e.g. '… the ladder properties it has (up to the ladder's one-step consequences), beside ¬ causally compact, in one statement', or name the count of conjuncts.
